name: Notion
description: Search, read and write pages and databases in your Notion workspace through Notion's hosted MCP server. Sign in with your Notion account.
examples: Search my Notion for the Q3 planning page and summarize the decisions that are still open.
Create a Notion page called "Weekly sync" with today's agenda: hiring update, launch checklist, budget.
Find the onboarding checklist in Notion and add a comment asking who owns the last step.

zh-CN.name: Notion
zh-CN.description: 通过 Notion 官方托管的 MCP 服务搜索、阅读和编写工作区里的页面与数据库。用 Notion 账号登录。
examples: 在 Notion 里找到第三季度规划页面，概括其中还没定下来的决定。
新建一个名为“每周同步”的 Notion 页面，写上今天的议程：招聘进展、上线清单、预算。
在 Notion 里找到入职清单，并在上面加一条评论，问最后一步由谁负责。
